title: Current Members of Parliament in Canada (House of Commons)
scope: Sitting federal Members of Parliament in the House of Commons of Canada, one entry per electoral district with a sitting member or recorded vacancy as of the research date. Excludes senators and provincial or municipal legislators.

sections.title: Sitting federal MPs by electoral district
sections.question: Who is the sitting Member of Parliament for each federal electoral district as of the research date?
sections.unit: sitting House of Commons member per electoral district

fields.name: member_name
fields.meaning: Full name of the person who holds the House of Commons seat for the district on the as-of date
fields.absence_meaning: No sitting member is recorded for the district on the as-of date, meaning the seat is vacant or unverified

fields.name: riding_name
fields.meaning: Official name of the federal electoral district the member represents
fields.absence_meaning: District name could not be determined from the source; the entry cannot be placed

fields.name: party_name
fields.meaning: Name of the party the member is recorded as belonging to on the as-of date, including Independent
fields.absence_meaning: Party affiliation is not recorded for the member on the as-of date

evidence_requirements: Official House of Commons or Elections Canada listing of members by electoral district dated on or near the as-of date
Confirmation of any vacancy, by-election or mid-term change affecting the district

interpretation_notes: Current means as of 2026-10-28, the supplied research date; membership changes after that date are out of scope.
One entry per electoral district because each district has at most one sitting member, so the riding name distinguishes entries and homonymous MPs are not confused.
Vacant seats are reported as unknown member rather than omitted, so the district count stays visible.
Party affiliation is recorded as of the as-of date and may differ from the party at election.

completion_checks.description: Every sitting House of Commons member as of the as-of date appears exactly once as a G1 entry.
completion_checks.measurement_method: Compare the G1 entries against the official House of Commons list of members as of the as-of date, checking one entry per riding.
limitations: Mid-term changes, resignations and by-elections may alter the list close to the as-of date
completion_checks.unit: sitting House of Commons member per electoral district
evidence_required: Official House of Commons or Elections Canada source listing members by electoral district

completion_checks.description: Every federal electoral district is accounted for as either occupied by a sitting member or recorded as vacant.
completion_checks.measurement_method: Reconcile the district list from an official source against G1 entries and vacancy records.
limitations: District list depends on the electoral boundaries in force on the as-of date
evidence_required: Official list of federal electoral districts in force on the as-of date
Vacancy record for any district without a sitting member
